articles.title: Farm plants may help fight infections, teen finds
articles.snippet: This middle-school student’s homegrown solutions may point to new ways to take down bacteria.
articles.summary: A middle-school student found that homegrown farm plants might help fight bacterial infections. These solutions could point to new ways to take down bacteria.

articles.title: This ‘anti-vampiric’ grave was double guarded against the undead
articles.snippet: A sickle across the throat and a padlock on her toe were meant to keep a 17th-century teen girl from resurrecting from the grave.
articles.summary: A 17th-century teenage girl was buried with a sickle across her throat and a padlock on her toe to stop her from coming back from the dead. These unusual items were used as double protection against the undead.

articles.title: Feeling nervous? Work that system to calm it down
articles.snippet: Scientists are exploring new ways to regain control of stressed-out nervous systems, including humming, tapping on the skin and cooling the face.
articles.summary: Scientists are exploring new ways to calm stressed-out nervous systems, such as humming, tapping on the skin, and cooling the face. These methods help people regain control of their bodies when they feel nervous.
